definitions.regional_power: sum linear band powers, expressed in dB using stable logsumexp; complete regional minutes only
definitions.bump: maximum regional minute dB minus median regional minute dB, >=3 observed minutes
definitions.correlation: Pearson between LF and high regional minute dB, >=3 paired minutes and nonconstant series
definitions.broadband_std: population standard deviation of all25 regional minute dB, >=3 complete minutes
definitions.AV_features: 4 physical values +4 defined flags +375 window-median-relative db/20 +375 observed mask +25 bandmedian-windowmedian/20 +25 temporal band std/20 +25 band q90-q10 span/20 +25 observed fraction
definitions.KS_scope: R6 TRAIN versus R6 INNER only; physical values with defined masks
limitations: Source-domain AV is not a Test-domain AV or a leaderboard-gap measurement.
Source-separated groups can still share sensors/recorder footprints. Reused TRAIN windows are grouped together.
AUC near .5 does not establish distribution equality; .85 is not an automatic fix threshold.
R5 INNER labels come from the old R4 synthetic generator, not natural observational vessel labels.
Oracle INNER mean is the best constant fitted to that INNER truth; it is a descriptive lower bound, not a deployable fit.
The unknown public Benchmark score is not a target-moment equation; no .24-.27 interval is fitted.

execution: one fixed grouped AV run; no Test, model-output or locked-array access
